items.q: How does the profit share work?
items.a: At end of each session day, net profit is calculated. A percentage is deducted from your balance. Losing days carry forward — no fees until prior losses are recovered.

items.q: What happens when the balance hits zero?
items.a: A 24-hour grace period activates. Bot pauses. Recharge at any time to resume. No penalties, no account loss.

items.q: How is the license fee charged?
items.a: Deducted automatically from your first charge. Pay $2,000 license + $3,000 charge = $3,000 operational balance.
USDT only. TRC-20 (TRON) or ERC-20 (Ethereum). Manual confirmation, typically under 30 minutes.

pricing.title: Only two fees

subscription.body: The only requirement to use the GUI. Valid 30 days from payment; the GUI stops when it expires.

profitShare.body: Applies only to net profit from bets placed through the GUI (manual or auto). Weeks close Saturday, invoiced Sunday.
profitShare.highlightBody: Losses carry forward and nothing is billed until they are recovered.

pricing.note: There are no other fees. Charge-balance restrictions have been abolished.

copyTrade.title: What is copy-trading?
copyTrade.body: The engine reads the table and sends bet decisions to your GUI. Your funds stay in your own account — we never hold them. Run fully automatic, or receive the calls and bet manually.

weekly.title: How weekly settlement works
weekly.body: Bets from Monday to Saturday are totalled. If net profit is positive, 30% is invoiced on Sunday. If negative, nothing is billed and the loss shows as a carry-over on your dashboard.

faq.title: FAQ
faq.q1: Do I still pay $200 on losing weeks?
faq.a1: Yes. The $200 is the subscription for using the GUI and is independent of results. The profit share, however, is only charged on winning weeks.
faq.q2: When does the carried loss disappear?
faq.a2: It is offset against future profits and disappears once the cumulative loss is fully recovered. Billing resumes at 30% of profit beyond that point.
faq.q3: Do I need to deposit funds with you?
faq.a3: No. Your funds always stay in your own casino account and wallet. We never take custody.
faq.q4: Why do I need to register a wallet?
faq.a4: By limiting deposits and withdrawals to one registered address, on-chain records can be reconciled with bet results, so the basis of every invoice can be verified at any time.
faq.q5: Can I stop at any time?
faq.a5: Yes. If you don't renew the subscription, nothing is billed after the expiry date. Only outstanding profit-share invoices need to be settled.

risk.label: risk disclosure
risk.body: Baccarat involves a large element of luck and no future profit is guaranteed. Past results do not predict future outcomes. Any losses are your own responsibility. Use only surplus funds — never living expenses or borrowed money. Not available to anyone under 18 or where prohibited by local law. If you feel you may have a gambling problem, please contact a professional helpline.
